description.value:
You gain the following Channel the Force option.

Telekinetic Slash. When an at-will force power that calls for a force attack roll or a saving throw deals damage, you may spend a use of Channel the Force and spend force points to add extra damage of the same type to that damage. Each point spent adds 1d8 of extra damage, up to the maximum listed in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.
